description: Odisha government launches Ama KrushAI, an AI-powered chatbot to provide personalized extension services to farmers in the state.
body_lead: Ama KrushAI is a recently launched chatbot in Odisha, which is dedicated to the agro sector and aims to provide farmers with the best agronomic practices, government schemes, and loan products from more than 40 commercial and cooperative banks. The Odisha government launched this initiative as a part of its efforts to improve the extension delivery for millions of farmers in the state. The Ama KrushAI is an artificial intelligence-driven ChatBot that has been built using the recently launched ChatGPT system and Bhashini, a language interpretation platform developed by IIT Madras.
